headers:
Attachment C Price Form and Proposal Form – This information is required directly in ionwave
under the Line Items Tab. Additionally this form is included in the invitation to bid package –
and is requesting the proposal form to also be included in this hard copy upload and is
requesting these forms to be uploaded separately. For clarification, please confirm that the
GC is to provide a hard copy of two uploaded documents in addition to providing these
numbers in ionwave.

We need one written form uploaded and one digitally
submitted form. You will complete Attachment C and only
upload it once. Please make sure that the Line Items Tab in
Ionwave is completed as well.
sample:
Please confirm that both playground structures are to receive a Hip Shade Structure, for a
quantity of (2) Hip Shade Structures that are each 38'x38' in size.

Sheet C008 shows the TW and BW of the retaining wall on the west side of the property. The
grading plan on Sheet C009 does not provide a TW or BW for the retaining wall located south
of the parking lot. In addition (per Sheet AS100 where the drop from top of retaining wall and
lower grade exceeds 30"), we are to provide a pipe guardrail on top of this retaining wall. Are
we to include in our bid this retaining wall that is south of the parking lot? If so, will Sheet
C009 be updated with the TW and BW for this retaining wall? Please clarify.

The only private wall that is part of this project is the along
the west side of the property. The wall that is proposed
along the road by the parking lot is not included in this
scope and will be done by separate contract. A note will be
added to C009 for clarity.

headers:
Spec 1.11 E 1 e states that each pair of speakers shall include one active and one passive.
Additionally, b. states "power required." However, the OWI ICM8 is not an active speaker.
Please clarify.

As per signal flows, the Cafeteria speakers require
connection to speaker amplifier.
sample:
TA-501 #2 shows (2) MM2 HDMI inputs in the cafeteria. However, TA-101 only shows (1). TA-
501 #2 also shows (1) MM2 as a passive HDMI input with an active HDMI cable. TA-501 #2 also
shows MM2 as an aux audio input. Please clarify the quantity of inputs and design intent.

Provide 'MM2' wall plate device per specifications. HT-AIM-
70-TX-WP
No specification is provided for audio antenna cabling. Please specify.

TA-500 #1 and TA-501 #2 show projection screen switch wired to projection screen via 22/2,
and an IP PoE relay also wired to the projection screen via 22/2. Da-Lite projection screens
take relay inputs into the switch, and the switch is wired by cat cable to the screen. The spec
also lists no specification for "page sensor." Additionally, the MPC3-302 has contact closure
input and relay output. Please clarify the design intent and required parts. Also reference
previous question about paging system.

Refer to revised signal flows issued with Addendum #3. The
intent is that the paging override mute program audio in the
space. The Control Relay shall enable screen up.down
control from the wall-mounted controller.

headers:
RFI #1, Item #8 – Gymnasium Wireless Microphone System: Quantity Specification 274100,
section 1.12.A.4 states that “there will be a single handheld wireless microphone system” for
the Gymnasium System. Specification 274100, section 1.12.E.5 includes doubled quantities for
the Wireless Microphone System and related components (wireless receiver, wireless
microphone, antennae) for the Gymnasium. Please confirm that there will be only one
Wireless Microphone System for the Gymnasium.
Two wireless microphone systems is required.
sample:
RFI #1, Item #9 – Cafeteria & Gymnasium In-Ceiling Storage Enclosures Specification 274100,
section 1.12.D.1 specifies provision and installation of a “Ceiling Enclosure with Integrated
Power and Data connections” The same section specifies Chief CMA170 for use this Ceiling
Enclosure. Drawings TA-500 and TA-501, Keyed Note #2 states “power by div. 26 and data by
div 27 shall install in ceiling enclosure.” Chief CMA170 is intended for use as pole-mounted
CPU/Device storage and does not include knockouts capable of integrating Power and Data.
Please confirm Power and Data will need to be installed into the Ceiling Enclosures and, if so,
provide a suitable make/model for the Ceiling Enclosures.

Provide Ceiling Enclosure and install per manufacturer
recommendations. Coordinate power and data with GC

RFI #1, Item #10 – Missing MDF/IDF Demarcation Lines Specification 274100, section 1.13.A.5
states “data cabling for devices shall follow the MDF/IDF demarcation lines as noted in the
structured cabling consultant drawings.” A-Series, T-Series, and TA-Series Drawings have no
drawn demarcation IDF/MDF lines. Please provide clarification for which rooms and systems
belong to each IDF.
